about: GitHub's reason from an error body (real 422/404 shapes), or null when the text is not GitHub's JSON.

cases.name: a GraphQL refusal, sent with a 200

given.body: {"data":{"repository":{"pullRequest":null}},"errors":[{"type":"NOT_FOUND","path":["repository","pullRequest"],"message":"Could not resolve to a PullRequest with the number of 999."}]}

cases.expect: Could not resolve to a PullRequest with the number of 999.
